newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Ara started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Ara started.

text.p: ING Barings analyst Ana Maria Mendez has started coverage of Mexican construction company Consorcio Ara SA de CV with a rating of buy.

-- "We expect volumes in 1997 to increase 40.4 percent and in 1998 27.7 percent and consequently real sales in peso terms to grow in 1997 and 1998 30 percent and 35.7 percent, respectively," Mendez wrote in a June 19 report.
-- Shares in the company closed Thursday at 28.10 pesos in Mexico City.
